messages:
Miri: Thinking of doing hill repeats at Twin Peaks at 6:15pm. Short, sharp sets (6x 60s) then jog down. Anyone fancy a post-work sweat? :sweat_drops:

Dan: I can make 6:15. How steep are we talking? I had leg day yesterday but could do an easy tempo.

Hannah: Ill come! Haven't done hill repeats in ages. Bringing reflective vest and headlamp in case it gets dim. :headphones:

Samir: Might be late, but I can join for the last 3 reps. Also bringing recovery gummies. :muscle:

Miri: It's the medium slope (not the screaming one). We meet at the east trailhead near the wooden bench. Quick warmup 6:10 then start.

Dan: Cool. Plan: warmup jog 8 min, drills, then 6 x 60s hard with 90s easy jog recoveries. First rep is a test pace so don't go all out. Heart rate-friendly.

Hannah: That sounds perfect. Also thinking of doing a mini challenge: whoever keeps best form gets dibs on post-run pizza. Stakes are high. :pizza:

Samir: I accept the terms. Also can someone bring a tiny foam roller if you have one? My calves are grumpy.

Miri: I'll bring a small roller. FYI: weather says light breeze, temps mid-50s.

fitbot: Reminder: group workout recorded - add to #fitstreak if you want credit. :bell:

Dan: Anyone need a ride back to the office? I have one seat.

Hannah: I'll take the seat if it's free. Thanks!

Miri: Awesome. See you all at 6:10 by the bench. Form > pace. No pizza tantrums please. :grin:
